matches.description: Watch China PR U23 vs UAE U23 highlights and goals from Asian Cup on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 23, 2026. Two of Asia's rising football powers faced off in a high-stakes encounter that tested their discipline and tactical resolve. Fans at the stadium witnessed a clash where every inch of the pitch was fiercely contested from the opening whistle. A Tactical Standoff in the Asian Cup On September 23, 2026 , China PR U23 and UAE U23 took to the field in a crucial Asian Cup fixture. The first half was a cagey affair with both sides looking to establish dominance in midfield. However, as the game transitioned into the second half , the tactical chess match evolved into a physical battle, with the referee being forced to take center stage to maintain order. The deadlock in discipline broke in the 52nd minute when W. Yudong received the first yellow card of the match. This set the tone for a period of high intensity where China PR U23 found themselves under the referee's scrutiny frequently. Z. Yuning was the next to be booked in the 67th minute, followed by H. Hetao ten minutes later, as the pressure of the tournament began to show on the pitch. Friction and Fouls in the Closing Stages The UAE U23 side was not immune to the rising temperature of the game. Shortly after China's third booking, M. J. A. D. A. Mansouri saw yellow in the 78th minute. The rhythm of the sports spectacle was constantly interrupted by whistles, preventing either side from creating a definitive chance to score a goal . As the clock ticked toward full-time, the bookings continued to mount. Y. Xi became the fourth Chinese player to enter the book in the 82nd minute. The drama concluded in stoppage time when B. Nasser of the UAE U23 received a caution in the 90+2nd minute. It was a night where defensive grit outweighed offensive flair, leaving both teams to reflect on a hard-fought battle in the heart of the competition.
